title: More time to pair. A clearer way to connect.
summary: Pairing stays connected while you confirm on the Mac, and QR scans explain when an app needs updating.

changes.title: Time to confirm your pairing
changes.text: Keep pairing connected while you check the verification code and accept on your Mac, instead of losing the connection after 15 seconds.

changes.title: Clearer version guidance
changes.text: Scanning a pairing QR code now checks the Mac’s advertised connection version first. If the apps are incompatible, PocketDesk tells you which one needs updating.

changes.title: Mac companion 1.2.1
changes.text: A signed and notarized companion release, available through Sparkle. It keeps protocol 25 compatibility with the iPhone 1.2 series and retains virtual workspaces, Keep Awake and shared-file controls.
